RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the February 25, 2009/Phalguna 6, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Defence; Earth Sciences; Home Affairs;
Labour and Employment; Rural Development;
Science and Technology; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
43
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Employment in Punjab under NREGA
*121. SHRI VARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of households in Punjab
registered for employment under the
National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
(NREGA) during 2008, district-wise;
(b) the number out of them given
employment for (i) 100 days, and (ii) less
than 100 days with total expenditure
incurred during the year, district-wise; and
(c) the nature of works undertaken and
completed in the State since the inception
of the scheme with the details of total
expenditure incurred thereon, year-wise
and district-wise?
Bomb blasts and terrorist activities in
the country
*122. SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR:
SHRI NAND KISHORE
Y ADAV:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) the number and details of bomb
blasts and terrorist activities that took place
in the country between 1st January, 2008
to 31st January, 2009, State-wise and
incident-wise separately;
(b) the details of the persons killed and
injured, State-wise;
(c) the ex-gratia payment made to them,
State and incident-wise; and
(d) the action taken during the said
period to strengthen the security of the
nation?
Capital investment in textile industry
†*123. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI SHIV ANAND TIWARI:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there has
been huge capital investment in the textile
industry during the period 2004 to 2008 in
the country;
(b) if so, the capital invested in the textile
industry in 2004 and at the end of 2008;
(c) out of this capital investment, the
capital invested in the sectors of textile

44
mills, powerloom, handloom and stitched
clothes in 2004 and 2008; and
(d) the average annual turnover in each
of the sector?
Development of leather sector
*124. MS. MABEL REBELLO:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
grant Rs. 913 crore for development of
leather sector in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the status of leather park projects
and which are the places where such parks
are proposed to be located in the country;
and
(d) the action plan under the above
project to upgrade the skills of rural
artisans?
Policemen killed in naxalite incidents
†*125. SHRI SHREEGOPAL V AYAS:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the total number of policemen killed
in naxalite incidents during the year 2007-
08 in the country;
(b) whether incidents of arms loot from
police stations have taken place;
(c) the State-wise details of jawans
killed in the said incidents;
(d) whether Government has made any
plan for the rehabilitation of their families;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Utilisation of sanctioned funds for
defence procurement
†*126. SHRI SATYA VRAT
CHATURVEDI:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) the funds sanctioned to procure
arms, equipments, ammunition etc. for the
army in the year 2008-09;
(b) the percentage of amount out of that
utilized by the army;
(c) the percentage of amount out of that
utilized for the fast-track procurement; and
(d) the reasons for not utilizing the total
sanctioned amount and the effect of that
on the preparation for country's defence?
Defence projects running behind
schedule
*127. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of projects including the
joint venture projects of the Ministry its
PSUs and subordinate offices costing over
Rs. 20 crore or more running behind
schedule;
(b) the reasons for the delay and the
total estimated loss to the exchequer; and
(c) the changes proposed in these
projects to complete them expeditiously
and to save expenditure?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

45
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Protection of jobs of displaced persons
due to global economic melt down
*128. SHRI RUDRA NARAY AN
PANY:
SHRI M. RAMA JOIS:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) how many workers in the country
have lost their jobs due to the recent global
economic melt down;
(b) the Ministry's estimation about the
job losses in the country in the current year
because of this; and
(c) the steps contemplated to protect
jobs and help the displaced workers?
Proposal from States on coastal
security
*129. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has received
schemes/proposals from various States
regarding comprehensive schemes on
coastal security including Tamil Nadu;
(b) if so, the details thereof indicating
therein the names of the States which had
forwarded the proposal; and
(c) the reaction of Government thereto?
Terrorists arrested for bomb blasts
†*130. SHRI A VTAR SINGH
KARIMPURI: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of bomb blasts in
the country from January, 2007 to
December, 2008;
(b) the details thereof, State-wise;
(c) the total number of arrested
terrorists found to be involved and
suspected therein;
(d) the details thereof, State-wise;
(e) the total number of terrorists who
have not been arrested yet; and
(f) the details thereof, State-wise?
Effect of import of silk from China on
weavers
†*131. SHRIMATI SUSHMA
SWARAJ: Will the Minister of TEXTILES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to import
of silk cloth from China, the silk saree
industry of Varanasi is almost on the verge
of closure;
(b) if so, whether Government has any
data about those weavers who have been
rendered jobless; and
(c) the efforts being made to protect the
people engaged in this industry?
Coordinated counter operation to
fight naxalism
*132. SHRI MAHENDRA
MOHAN:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether in view of recent attack by
Naxalites on security forces in Gadchiroli
district of Maharashtra, the Union
Government has now devised a long-haul
strategy that will involve simultaneous
coordinated counter operations in all left
wing extremism hit States and to plug the
all possible escape routes of Maoists;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the Union Government has
circulated a questionnaire to all the States
seeking information on various counts like
the strength of their respective police force,

46
need for additional weapons, extent of
Central forces engaged etc.; and
(d) if so, the response of the State
Governments thereto?
Relief in loan to weavers
†*133. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI SHIV ANAND TIWARI:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has formulated a plan to provide relief in
loan to weavers;
(b) if so, the outlines of the plan;
(c) whether Government has made any
assessment about the loans given to
weavers; and
(d) if so, the average loan amount on
weavers at national level in December, 2008
in the country?
Effect of shortage of AJTs on trainings
*134. SHRIMATI   MOHSINA
KIDWAI:
SHRIMATI  SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether in view of insufficient
number of Hawk Advanced Jet Trainers
(AJTs), the Indian Air Force has decided to
reduce by half the number of personnel
who will train on these recently inducted
aircrafts;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether a good number of Hawks
have been grounded for want of spares,
maintenance or quality control issues etc.;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the corrective steps Government
proposes to take in this regard?
BPL persons in the country
*135. SHRI RAMDAS AGARW AL:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that out of 30
crore persons Below Poverty Line (BPL)
in the country, about 22 crore, i.e. 73 per
cent live in rural areas;
(b) whether Government has so far
examined reasons for rural poverty;
(c) whether Government has set up any
mechanism to verify the actual BPL list
(State-wise); and
(d) the steps Government has taken so
far to achieve "Millennium Development
Goal of eardicating extreme hunger and
poverty" under its various schemes like
NREGA, IGNOAPS, SGSY etc. by 2015?
Fake domicile certificates for
recruitment in Army
*136. SHRI B.S. GNANADESIKAN:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some youths
have provided fake domicile certificates
purported to be issued by the State
Governments during recruitment in Army;
(b) if so, the action taken by Government;
(c) whether Government has issued any
instructions to State Governments to be
vigilant in providing domicile certificates
for recruitment in Army, since it is an issue
of national security; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

47
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
NEW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 19th February, 2009 Secretary-General.
Magha 30, 1930 (Saka)
Slowdown in foreign investment
*137. SHRI PRAKASH JAVADEKAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is
slowdown in foreign investment in India;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of steps being taken by
Government to attract foreign business?
Success of NREGA
*138. SHRI RAJNITI PRASAD: Will
the Minister of RURAL DEVELOP-
MENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that National
Rural Employment Guarantee Act,
(NREGA) the ambitious scheme of
Government to provide income to the rural
poor has not been as successful as intended;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the job
cards prepared for the beneficiaries are kept
by the Gram Pradhans and the money that
is meant to be given to them is actually not
given; and
(c) if so, the steps Government would
take to minimise the leakage in the scheme?
Viability of SEZs in present economic
scenario
*139. SHRI D. RAJA: Will the Minister
of COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has done any
study or assessed the impact of the recent
global economic slowdown on the use and
future of the numerous Special Economic
Zones (SEZs) sanctioned in the country in
the last two years;
(b) whether it is a fact that the inter-
national economic slowdown will have an
impact on Indian exports;
(c) if so, whether Government will do a
re-think on the utility of the SEZs in the
near future;
(d) whether it is also a fact that the
targets of new units have fallen behind in
the SEZs; and
(e) the steps proposed by Government
to review the viability of SEZs in the
present economic scenario?
Habitations under PMGSY
†*140. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELW AL: Will the Minister of
RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of unconnected
habitations having population of 250, 500
and 1000 under Pradhan Mantri Gram
Sadak Yojana (PMGSY), State-wise and
Union Territory-wise;
(b) the details of reasons for not
connecting these habitations;
(c) by when these habitations are likely
to be connected;
(d) the details of funds released under
this scheme during the last three years,
State-wise; and
(e) the details of habitations which were
connected by roads under this scheme
during the last three years, State-wise?

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)
Commerce and Industry : 124, 137, 139,
Defence : 126, 127, 134, 136,
Earth Sciences :—
Home Affairs : 122, 125, 129, 130, 132,
Labour and Employment : 128,
Rural Development : 121, 135, 138, 140,
Science and Technology :—
Textiles : 123, 131, 133.
48
MGIPMRND—707RS—19.02.2009.
